message.content:
I don’t have a built‑in function that pulls holiday calendars directly, but I can give you a quick rundown of the **federal long weekends** that occurred in Canada during 2023. (Keep in mind that some provinces have additional holidays that may create extra long weekends.)

| Date | Holiday | Weekend Type | Notes |
|------|---------|--------------|-------|
| **Feb 18–20** | Family Day (Ontario, Manitoba, Saskatchewan, New Brunswick) | Friday–Sunday | Family Day fell on Monday, Feb 20, giving a long weekend. |
| **Apr 7–10** | Good Friday & Easter Monday | Friday–Monday | Good Friday was on Apr 7; Easter Monday on Apr 10. |
| **May 20–22** | Victoria Day | Friday–Sunday | Victoria Day was on Monday, May 22. |
| **Sep 2–4** | Labour Day | Friday–Sunday | Labour Day was on Monday, Sep 4. |
| **Oct 7–9** | Thanksgiving | Friday–Sunday | Thanksgiving was on Monday, Oct 9. |
| **Dec 23–25** | Christmas | Friday–Sunday | Christmas was on Monday, Dec 25. |

### Quick Summary
- **Family Day** (Ontario, Manitoba, Saskatchewan, New Brunswick) – Feb 18–20  
- **Good Friday & Easter Monday** – Apr 7–10  
- **Victoria Day** – May 20–22  
- **Labour Day** – Sep 2–4  
- **Thanksgiving** – Oct 7–9  
- **Christmas** – Dec 23–25  

If you need province‑specific holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, or the various “Heritage Days” in British Columbia), let me know and I can add those as well.
